name: CANCELLATION HEARTS
description: Hearts variant: matching cards in a trick cancel (no points). Different scoring from base Hearts.

content.text: Hearts variant: matching cards in a trick cancel (no points). Different scoring from base Hearts.

Hearts first appeared at the end of the nineteenth century and is popular in many countries. Cancellation Hearts is an American variant for six to ten players using two 52-card packs shuffled together; when identical cards are played to the same trick they cancel each other for trick-taking but still carry penalty points if they are hearts or the Queen of Spades.
Cancellation Hearts is commonly played by six to ten players; this build uses four players with one deck. No partnerships; play is clockwise.
Standard 52-card deck. The classic Cancellation form uses two 52-card packs shuffled together for six to ten players; this entry uses one pack for four players.
Standard 52-card deck. The classic Cancellation form uses two 52-card packs shuffled together for six to ten players; this entry uses one pack for four players.

All cards are dealt out as far as they go; any leftover go to a face-down kitty taken by the winner of the first trick. For 4 players, 13 cards each, one at a time. After the deal, pass three cards (left, right, across, no pass by round).
